title: Twisted Oak Crook
summary: A dryad’s +1 staff with unusually high two-handed damage and Ensnared.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile and Dippable quarterstaff. 5 ft melee. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d6 + 1 one-handed or 3d6 + 1 two-handed Bludgeoning, plus Strength.
fields.Topple: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Hit for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Prone for 1 turn. Breaks Concentration on application.
fields.Ensnared: DC 13 Dexterity save prevents Ensnared for 1 turn. It stops movement and opportunity attacks, imposes Disadvantage on attacks and Dexterity saves, and grants Advantage to attackers. The dryad’s separate Grasp of the Forest passive can apply Entangled.
fields.Availability: Carried by summoned Dryads. Unavailable as normal loot.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
